<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Water resource governance:</strong> The BJP convened a two-day &#x27;Jal Manthan&#x27; workshop in Delhi, bringing together water resources ministers from 14 party-ruled states to align on national water policy strategies.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has quashed existing FIRs related to Jantar Mantar protests across India while authorizing the filing of fresh FIRs against 2,873 individuals.</li>
</ul>
